notes.title: v1.2.1 Official Achievement Hotfix
notes.notes:
This update contains small achievements fixes

Finally have figured out the issue with Unity and Steamworks not identifying and setting achievements. This issue was caused by an out-of-date Unity version. Finally has been officially fixed and tested in this update!

notes.title: v1.1 Update
notes.notes:
Farstorm 1.1 Update

Files were recovered for Farstorm! The highly anticipated 1.1 update is here!

Fixed so many bugs, fixed so many visual glitches, updated animations, included new UI, fixed UI, and much more.

Please Enjoy, a more polished Farstorm.

More Story coming soon!

notes.title: Farstorm 2 Controller Update
notes.notes:
Farstorm now has controller support and this video includes a little sneak peek into the intro. Everything is a little unpolished, but for now, it's looking great!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=a9NSck580OY

notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.notes:
Farstorm's gonna get spooky!
On Halloween, Farstorm 1.1 will be releasing.

Expect spooky pumpkins, new weapons, bug fixes, and more!

notes.title: Update ETA's and more!
notes.notes:
Want to get updated news on when bugs will be fixed, new content will be added, and when updates will be pushed to Steam?
Check out the Trello page, and review the current fixes and ideas going on, and pitch in on the Steam Community with bug reports and ideas!

Trello: https://trello.com/b/HJqQQfB5/farstorm

Thank you for being apart of Farstorm!

notes.title: 1.0.2 Release
notes.notes:
The version contains general bug fixes and optimizations

Attempted to fix character stammer issue, seems to appear on certain builds
Fixed Crash on exit
Shader Changes
Small code changes / other small tweaks (some spell buffs, etc)

notes.title: Major Hotfix
notes.notes: A bug was found in some gameplay videos, inside of Beak Villiage, that caused lighting to be broken and self-illumination was maxed out. This has been corrected, please update to the latest if you haven't already, thank you.

notes.title: 1.0 Release!
notes.notes:
Farstorm has released it's first stable version. 
Steam release is less than 10 hours away!
In this version

New Shaders
General Bug Fixes (wrong bump maps, etc)
Fixed Some UI elements
New Skills! Lighting and basis for Pet Summoning!
